name: Qibla Tower
summary: A tall mosque rises through measured setbacks into a compact compass-needle cap.
why: The tower, prayer hall, doorway, window, and compass needle all share x=54. Every setback joins the next solidly. A slender lozenge with a real inset split caps the top lantern and overlaps it by five units, giving the tower a small directional detail within its own structure.
risk: The small compass cap supports the architecture instead of dominating it. At 24px its inset becomes subtle, while the stepped mosque and horseshoe entrance remain visible.
sub2: A restrained direction cue on the same axis
reasonToChoose: You want a tall geometric identity centered on the direction of prayer.
